title: mini hotplate
text: mini hotplate. I purchased this mini hot plate to use with my very small battery box during a short power outage.  It is super small - the burner is about the size of a cup warmer.  But in a pinch, I think it will work well.  I store it with the battery box in my outage emergency kit.  I expect it work just as I need it to in a pinch - having said that - I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Mini Stove - Portable 500W Electric Mini Stove Stove Cooking Plate Hot Plate Multifunction Home Heater
features: Fast Heat Up - The furnace heats up fast, with a high surface temperature, up to 570°C.
High Thermal Efficiency - the surface temperature of the cooktop is high, the internal temperature is low, and the thermal efficiency is high.
Easy to Clean - The stove's heat pipes are removable and the electric mini stove is very easy to clean.
Applicable - furnace temperature can be controlled at will, suitable for soup and porridge. It is also suitable for hot pot and has the same function as an induction cooker.
Portable - The portable design of the stove is safe to use and is a must-have household appliance.
